title: Achemenes son of Darius
summary: Raleigh names Achemenes son of Darius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Achemenes, a sonne of Darius, gouernor of Aegypt. He is not Achaemenes, the sonne of Perses, from whom the Achaemenidae are named. The one-word title would not keepe the two apart, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
